reference_gaps: TS3 is identified as the official Transolver-3 family, but the exact server model file/commit cannot be verified.
Slide 4 does not specify depth, heads, slices, width, MLP ratio or optimizer settings; the official volume preset is a stated substitute.
Model constructor defaults are 5 layers / 32 slices / MLP ratio 1; official surface preset uses 24 layers. The chosen volume preset is explicit rather than silently treating either as slide settings.
The exact 25-feature schema and long-run target scaling constants are unavailable.
